sql:
with c as (select max(started_at) t from incentive_discovery_cycles where errors = 0),
w as (select (select t from c) e, (select t from c) - interval '24 hours' s24, (select t from c) - interval '7 days' s7)
select
 (select t from c) as last_clean_cycle,
 (select count(*) from incentive_programs) as rows_total,
 (select count(*) from incentive_programs p, c where p.superseded_at is null and p.last_seen_at >= c.t) as stamped_last_pass,
 (select count(*) from incentive_programs p, c where p.superseded_at is null and p.last_seen_at >= c.t and p.status_observed = 'paid_out' and p.end_date < c.t) as stamped_paidout_ended,
 (select count(*) from incentive_programs p, c where p.superseded_at is null and p.last_seen_at >= c.t and not (p.status_observed = 'paid_out' and p.end_date < c.t)) as stamped_after_A,
 (select count(distinct program_id) from incentive_programs p, w where p.first_seen_at <= w.e and p.last_seen_at >= w.s24) as v1_24h,
 (select count(distinct program_id) from incentive_programs p, w where p.first_seen_at <= w.e and p.last_seen_at >= w.s24 and (p.end_date is null or p.end_date >= w.s24)) as v2_24h,
 (select count(distinct program_id) from incentive_programs p, w where p.first_seen_at <= w.e and p.last_seen_at >= w.s7) as v1_7d,
 (select count(distinct program_id) from incentive_programs p, w where p.first_seen_at <= w.e and p.last_seen_at >= w.s7 and (p.end_date is null or p.end_date >= w.s7)) as v2_7d,
 (select count(distinct program_id) from incentive_programs p, w where p.first_seen_at <= w.e and p.last_seen_at >= w.s24 and p.incentive_type = 'liquidity' and (p.end_date is null or p.end_date >= w.s24)) as v2_24h_liquidity
